rca_of_issue: Repro: Register/login -> complete onboarding -> upload PDF -> Setup -> grant consent -> click 'Analisar documento'. Browser logs show CORS/preflight failure to https://wdjaggnxdbbovupfzslj.supabase.co/functions/v1/analyze-document (non-OK preflight), so function response never reaches frontend. UI then marks local status as Erro and shows retry, but refresh reverts to Aguardando análise because backend document was not updated by failed request. Mitigation: ensure analyze-document is deployed and correctly handling OPTIONS/CORS at Supabase edge layer, then keep frontend status transitions aligned with persisted backend state.
